newsitem.title: LATVIA: EBRD OKAYS STATE'S SALE OF ITS UNIBANKA STAKE.
newsitem.headline: EBRD OKAYS STATE'S SALE OF ITS UNIBANKA STAKE.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has okayed the government's plan to sell its entire stake in Unibanka, the newspaper Diena reported on Thursday.
The government currently has a 33.3 percent stake in Unibanka, the country's second largest bank, while the EBRD holds 20 percent.
The two sides had previously agreed that the state would maintain at least ten percent of Unibanka's shares while the EBRD was a shareholder.
But the EBRD has decided that the state can sell off all of its shares if it wants, the paper quoted Victor Shadinov, the legal director of the Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA), as saying.
The government said in March that it planned to sell 23 percent of its shares in the bank.
